title: DRAFT: audit log export requests (intake notes)
author: Lauren Bishop
content:
# Purpose
Working notes for handling customer requests to export audit logs.

# Intake
- Customer company, deployment mode, desired sink (S3 | GCS | Azure Blob), bucket + prefix.

# Priority
- P2 for standard requests
- P1 if tied to a customer audit deadline within 30 days

# Routing
- All deployment modes: route to Eng Platform (platform ops owns the export connector).

# Open questions
- Do we need Legal for cross-region exports? TBD with Priya.
